statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low because no persistent one-way NQ path is verified, while event Stress is high ahead of the U.S. open and 14:00 UTC policy/data cluster.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The main conditional risk window is 13:20–15:30 UTC; higher Tail would require observed sustained extension, shallow pullbacks and cross-asset confirmation.
headline: Low Tail, high event stress before Warsh
body: Reuters reports Nasdaq futures about 0.1% lower with mixed Asian equities; the 10-year yield was 4.6723%, the 2-year 4.2279%, and Brent $89.63. Direct NQ path evidence is limited to delayed quotes, so no persistent failed-retracement structure is verified. Marvell fell more than 6% after hours despite higher annual forecasts, adding semiconductor divergence.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail rose into WATCH during Thursday's Nvidia-led and event windows, then returned to low as mixed structure reappeared. The 06:00 UTC August 27 slot had no published assessment.
outlookSummary: Risk concentrates at 13:20–15:30 UTC around the cash open, Chicago PMI, and the 14:00 UTC Warsh/Michigan/CES cluster. Future Tail remains conditional on realized NQ persistence; weekend hours shift toward headline and reopening-gap risk as live futures close.

forecast.analysis: Premarket direction can raise Stress but is not Tail evidence by itself. The key conditional test is whether any move repeatedly extends after failed retracements.
Pre-event positioning may become less liquid as the U.S. morning approaches. Tail stays low unless price efficiency strengthens and cross-assets confirm a one-way path.
Stress rises into the U.S. cash-open approach. A pre-open impulse would matter for Tail only if it survives a meaningful retracement and holds near its extreme.
The cash open and 13:45 UTC Chicago PMI create the first concentrated repricing window. WATCH is conditional on sustained extension rather than event importance alone.
The 14:00 UTC Warsh, Michigan and CES benchmark cluster is the peak event-risk hour. Tail reaches the top of WATCH only conditionally; a two-way response would reduce it quickly.
After the 14:00 UTC cluster, WATCH persists only if the first move extends through shallow or failed retracements and cross-asset confirmation remains aligned.
Event digestion should clarify whether repricing is persistent. Two-way acceptance and volatility decay would return Tail to low; an unresolved delayed second leg would lift it.
Mid-session risk depends on whether technology breadth and Treasury yields reinforce the same NQ direction. Conflicting signals favor mixed conditions and lower Tail.
Afternoon trading should absorb the morning repricing. Holding near a session extreme with repeated failed pullbacks would be the main conditional Tail amplifier.
Power hour adds conditional continuation risk. WATCH requires renewed directional efficiency and failed retracements; ordinary late-day volatility alone does not qualify.
After the cash close, NQ futures enter their final Friday trading hour. Tail stays low unless unresolved direction remains efficient into the 21:00 UTC weekend close.
NQ futures are closed for the weekend from 21:00 UTC. Live price-path Tail is unobservable; remaining risk shifts to headlines and the eventual reopening gap.
With futures closed, continuous price discovery is unavailable. New information can alter reopening Stress but cannot establish observed Tail persistence.
Weekend closure continues. Geopolitical or policy headlines may change expected gap risk, while Tail remains conditional on post-reopen directional persistence.
No live futures path is available. Risk centers on whether material new information changes the expected reopening gap rather than on observed continuation.
Without continuous trading, confidence gradually fades. Tail remains low absent a material catalyst that later produces persistent post-reopen structure.
Weekend geopolitical developments can raise reopening Stress. Tail still requires an observed persistent path after futures reopen.
Closed-market conditions persist. An abnormal future reopening gap would be a checkpoint, not proof of Tail without subsequent failed retracements.
Headline-driven gap risk remains the main variable while NQ is closed. Tail stays low until future trading supplies evidence of persistent directional efficiency.
Late-weekend conditions remain non-observable for price path. New catalysts may change Stress, while Tail stays conditional on post-reopen structure.
